verdict.rationale: Martin is a natural-language AI assistant operated entirely by telling it what to do over phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email and Slack. First-party docs show natural-language control of calendar, email, Slack, reminders, to-dos and notes, with example commands like "Text Jon my arrival time" and a spoken notes request. Hands-on community reports confirm it handles complicated natural-language requests correctly the first time and is used hourly for to-do management.
